# 2 Samuel Chapter 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 173r–174r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/2SA_006_page_001.jpg, 2SA_006_page_002.jpg | **DSS:** 4QSamᵃ (4Q51) fragments extant

---

**6:1** And-gathered again David all [the]-chosen in-Yisra'el, thirty thousand.

**6:2** And-arose and-went David and-all the-people who [were] with-him from-Ba'aley-Yehudah, to-bring-up from-there [the]-ark of-the-God, which is-called by-[the]-Name — [the]-name of-YHWH of-hosts, [the]-One-sitting [upon the]-keruvim upon-it.

**6:3** And-they-set [the]-ark of-the-God upon a-cart new, and-carried-it from-[the]-house of-Avinadav which [was] on-the-hill. And-Uzzah and-Achyo, sons of-Avinadav, [were]-driving the-cart the-new.

**6:4** And-they-carried-it from-[the]-house of-Avinadav which [was] on-the-hill, with [the]-ark of-the-God, and-Achyo [was]-walking before the-ark.

**6:5** And-David and-all [the]-house of-Yisra'el [were]-playing [mesachaqim] before YHWH with-all [instruments of]-cypress-wood: and-with-lyres [kinnorot] and-with-harps [nevalim] and-with-tambourines [tuppim] and-with-sistrums [mena'an'im] and-with-cymbals [tseltselim].

**6:6** And-they-came to [the]-threshing-floor of-Nakhon, and-stretched-out Uzzah to [the]-ark of-the-God and-seized-it, for [the]-oxen stumbled [shametū].

**6:7** And-burned [the]-anger of-YHWH against-Uzzah, and-struck-him there the-God on the-error [shal], and-he-died there beside [the]-ark of-the-God.

**6:8** And-it-burned to-David because YHWH had-broken-out [parats] a-breaking [perets] upon Uzzah; and-he-called that place Perets-Uzzah [Breaking of-Uzzah], unto this day.

**6:9** And-feared David YHWH on-that day and-said, "How shall-come [the]-ark of-YHWH to-me?"

**6:10** And-not was-willing David to-remove [the]-ark of-YHWH to-him, to [the]-City of-David; and-turned-it-aside David [to the]-house of-Oved-Edom the-Gittite.

**6:11** And-dwelt [the]-ark of-YHWH [in the]-house of-Oved-Edom the-Gittite three months, and-blessed YHWH Oved-Edom and-all his-house.

**6:12** And-it-was-told to-the-king David, saying, "YHWH has-blessed [the]-house of-Oved-Edom and-all that [is]-to-him, on-account-of [the]-ark of-the-God." And-went David and-brought-up [the]-ark of-the-God from-[the]-house of-Oved-Edom to [the]-City of-David with-joy [simchah].

**6:13** And-it-was when-had-marched the-bearers of-[the]-ark of-YHWH six steps, and-he-sacrificed an-ox and-a-fatling.

**6:14** And-David [was]-whirling [mekharker] with-all strength before YHWH; and-David [was]-girded [with] a-linen ephod [efod bad].

**6:15** And-David and-all [the]-house of-Yisra'el [were]-bringing-up [the]-ark of-YHWH with-shouting [teru'ah] and-with-[the]-sound of-[the]-shofar.

**6:16** And-it-was, [the]-ark of-YHWH came [to the]-City of-David, and-Mikhal daughter of-Sha'ul looked-down through the-window, and-saw the-king David leaping [mefazzeiz] and-whirling [mekharker] before YHWH, and-she-despised-him in-her-heart.

**6:17** And-they-brought [the]-ark of-YHWH and-set-it in-its-place in-[the]-midst of-the-tent that David had-pitched for-it, and-offered David burnt-offerings [olot] and-peace-offerings [shelamim] before YHWH.

**6:18** And-finished David from-offering the-burnt-offering and-the-peace-offerings, and-blessed the-people in-[the]-name of-YHWH of-hosts.

**6:19** And-distributed to-all the-people, to-all [the]-multitude of-Yisra'el, from-man and-unto woman, to-each a-cake of-bread [challat lechem] one, and-one portion [eshpar] and-one raisin-cake [ashishah]. And-went all the-people, each-man to-his-house.

**6:20** And-returned David to-bless his-house, and-went-out Mikhal daughter of-Sha'ul to-meet David and-said, "How honored-himself today the-king of-Yisra'el, who uncovered-himself today before-[the]-eyes of-[the]-maidservants of-his-servants, as-one-of-the-empty-ones [reyqim] uncovers-himself uncovering [higgalot yiggaleh]!"

**6:21** And-said David to Mikhal, "Before YHWH, who chose-me over your-father and-over all his-house, to-appoint-me as-ruler [nagid] over [the]-people of-YHWH, over Yisra'el — and-I-will-play [sahaqtiy] before YHWH.

**6:22** And-I-will-be-lightly-esteemed [niqalotiy] even-more than-this, and-I-will-be-low in-my-[own]-eyes; and-with the-maidservants of-whom you-spoke, with-them I-will-be-honored."

**6:23** And-to-Mikhal daughter of-Sha'ul there-was-not to-her a-child, until [the]-day of-her-death.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.5 — mesachaqim:** The same root שׂחק used in 2:14 for the deadly "play" at Gibeon now describes joyful worship. The semantic range of the root encompasses both deadly combat and ecstatic praise.

**v.7 — shal:** The word שַׁל is a hapax legomenon. It may mean "error," "rashness," "irreverence," or "stumbling." The cause of YHWH's wrath against Uzzah is left deliberately opaque — the narrator does not explain what the "error" was.

**v.14 — mekharker:** The verb כרכר means "to whirl/dance/pirouette" — an intense, ecstatic physical movement. Combined with *mefazzeiz* (v.16, "leaping/jumping"), the picture is of uninhibited, full-body worship.

**v.20 — higgalot yiggaleh:** The infinitive absolute emphasizes Michal's accusation: David "utterly uncovered himself." The verb *galah* can mean both physical exposure and social disgrace.

*— EMET*
